PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX lime: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/lime#>
PREFIX marl: <http://www.gsi.upm.es/ontologies/marl/ns#>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?italianWord ?parmigianoWord ?polarityValue
WHERE {
    # Italian lemma from the main LiITA LemmaBank
    ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                  ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord ;
                  dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/lemma/LemmaBank> .

    # Sentix polarity entry (outside graphs) with negative value
    ?polarityEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ;
                   marl:hasPolarity ?polarity ;
                   marl:hasPolarityValue ?polarityValue .
    FILTER(?polarityValue < 0)

    # Translation from Italian lexical entry to Parmigiano lexical entry
    ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ;
                     vartrans:translatableAs ?parmigianoLexEntry .

    # Parmigiano lexical entry belongs to the Parmigiano lexicon
    ?parmigianoLexEntry ^lime:entry <http://liita.it/data/id/LexicalReources/DialettoParmigiano/Lexicon> ;
                        ontolex:canonicalForm ?parmigianoLemma .
    ?parmigianoLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?parmigianoWord .
}
ORDER BY ?polarityValue

PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?dialectLemma) AS ?total)
WHERE {
    GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> {
        ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                      ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    }

    ?emotionEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    GRAPH <http://w3id.org/elita> {
        ?emotionEntry elita:HasEmotion ?emotion .
        ?emotion rdfs:label ?emotionLabel .
        FILTER(STR(?emotionLabel) = "Rabbia")
    }

    ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?dialectLexEntry .
    ?dialectLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?dialectLemma .
    ?dialectLemma dcterms:isPartOf ?dialectLemmaBank .
    ?dialectLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?dialectWord .

    FILTER(regex(str(?dialectLemmaBank), "Dialetto", "i"))
}

SELECT DISTINCT ?hypernymWord
WHERE {
    SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
        ?word ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?writtenRep ] .
        FILTER(STR(?writtenRep) = "veicolo")

        ?word ontolex:sense ?sense .

        ?sense lexinfo:hyponym ?hypernymSense .

        ?hypernymEntry ontolex:sense ?hypernymSense ;
                       ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?hypernymWord ] .
    }
}

  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    ?word ontolex:sense [ skos:definition ?definition ] ;
          ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?writtenRep ] .
    FILTER(REGEX(STR(?definition), "terra", "i"))
  }
}

SELECT ?italianLemma ?italianWord
WHERE {
  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> {
    ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                  lila:hasPOS lila:noun ;
                  ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    FILTER(REGEX(STR(?italianWord), "ità$"))
  }
}

PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX lime: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/lime#>
PREFIX marl: <http://www.gsi.upm.es/ontologies/marl/ns#>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?italianWord ?sicilianWord
WHERE {
    SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
        ?donnaWord ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?donnaWr ] .
        FILTER(STR(?donnaWr) = "donna")
        ?donnaWord ontolex:sense ?donnaSense .
        ?donnaSense lexinfo:hypernym ?hyponymSense .
        ?resultWord ontolex:sense ?hyponymSense .
    }

    ?resultWord ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> {
        ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                      ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    }

    FILTER(!CONTAINS(STR(?italianWord), " "))

    ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?sicilianLexEntry .
    ?sicilianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?sicilianLemma .
    ?sicilianLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                   ontolex:writtenRep ?sicilianWord .

    FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = STR(?sicilianWord))
}
ORDER BY ?italianWord

PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT ?italianWord ?parmigianoWord ?italianLemma ?parmigianoLemma
WHERE {
  # Italian lemma with written representation "pane"
  ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
  FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = "pane")

  # Italian lexical entry linked to the lemma
  ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .

  # Translation link from Italian entry to Parmigiano entry
  ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?parmigianoLexEntry .

  # Parmigiano lexical entry to its lemma
  ?parmigianoLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?parmigianoLemma .

  # Identify Parmigiano lemma and get its written representation
  ?parmigianoLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoParmigiano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                   ontolex:writtenRep ?parmigianoWord .
}

                  ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    FILTER(STR(?italianWord) IN ("banco", "piano", "campo", "punto"))
